subject: Discovery recap: embeddings & rerank for Cascade Retail
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@cascade-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Quick intro - embeddings/rerank for Cascade Retail

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking the meeting yesterday intro with your team. We run search & recommendations for Cascade Retail and are looking to improve click-through and conversion on product search. We currently use a hybrid approach: lexical search for recall with a lightweight ANN vector reranker (Pinecone + Faiss for experiments).

High-level pain: relevance drifts on promotions, expensive infra at scale, and slow discovery of related products. We want to assess options to improve rerank quality while keeping per-query latency below ~100ms and costs predictable.

Can we schedule a short discovery next week to go through our stack and requirements? I'm including Elena (our head of search infra) on the followup.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Search & Personalization
Cascade Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@cascade-retail.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@cascade-retail.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T13:30:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps - embeddings / rerank (notes)

Samir / Elena - thanks for the productive call today. Recap below (please flag anything I missed):

Pain points / goals:
- Relevance drift around promotional periods and new SKUs; human tuning is brittle.
- Need improved rerank quality to drive CTR and conversions without increasing tail latency.
- Want predictable unit economics (cost per query) and ability to scale to peak shopping events.

Current stack / constraints:
- Embeddings: in-house 512-d vectors (training + production embedder).
- Vector store: pilot on Pinecone; some experiments with Faiss on EC2 for cold queries.
- Metadata & ranking signals: Postgres for catalog + streaming enrichments.
- Ingestion: nightly batch ingest ~400k-600k vectors; occasional hourly incremental sync for hot SKUs.
- Scale target: starting index ~80M vectors, planning for 120M+ within 6-12 months.
- QPS: average ~25 qps, peak ~60 qps during promotions; latency SLO for rerank layer: 50-100ms (p99 budget tighter for immediate UX).

Success criteria (what'll make this project successful):
1) 5-10% relative uplifts in CTR on search sessions (A/B measurable)
2) 95th/99th percentile rerank latency below defined SLOs (50-100ms)
3) Clear unit-cost model (cost per 1k queries) with options for reserved capacity during peaks
4) Smooth ingestion/refresh path for 100M+ index with minimal operational overhead

Suggested technical approach & considerations we discussed:
- Candidate prefiltering to reduce ANN calls (lexical or category filters) before vector rerank.
- Quantization and model selection to reduce per-token and per-query compute for rerank rescores.
- KV/prefix caching for hot SKUs and repeated queries to lower cost and improve tail latency.
- Explore Redwood's Dedicated/reserved capacity option for predictable throughput during events.

Attachments: I attached the call slides and a draft mutual action plan that aligns milestones and deliverables (POC scope, timeline, success checkpoints).

Next steps (agreed):
1) Redwood to provide a short POC proposal and sizing estimate (including dedicated capacity option) - action: Marissa (ETA: 3/6).
2) Cascade to share sample dataset stats (embeddings dim, sample size, typical query examples) + any security/compliance questions - action: Elena (ETA: 3/5).
3) Tech deep-dive with Mateo to review ingestion and latency optimizations (schedule after Elena shares dataset) - action: Mateo / Elena (ETA: schedule by 3/9).

If this looks right, I'll push the mutual action plan as an editable sheet so we can track owners and dates.

Thanks again - excited to help here.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: discovery_slides.pdf (15 pages), mutual_action_plan.xlsx

From: Samir Gupta <samir@cascade-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@cascade-retail.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps - embeddings / rerank (notes)

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap and for the slides. This aligns with our notes. A few clarifications from Elena/us:

- Index details: we currently have ~80M vectors live, expect to grow to ~120M over the next 9 months. Embedding dim is 512.
- Query patterns: avg QPS ~25, peak ~60 for promotions; most queries expect top-k rerank of k=10 after lexical prefilter.
- Ingestion: nightly full batch 400k-600k, hourly delta pushes of ~10-20k when needed.
- Vector DB: Pinecone today; we are open to alternatives if it improves cost/latency and integrates with our infra.

Elena asked if you can include rough pricing bands for: hosted pay-as-you-go, dedicated reserved capacity for peak events, and estimated infra cost for an in-region dedicated pool (US-East). Also any notes on support/SLAs for large index operations (reindex, snapshots, audit logs).

Technical contact is Elena (cc'd) - please include her on any proposal docs. We can share sample embeddings and a small query set by 3/5.

Happy to move forward with the POC proposal. Please loop Mateo to schedule the technical deep dive.

Thanks,
Samir
